title: Large tool catalogs keep a stable on-demand prompt prefix
acceptance: Large catalogs at or above either auto threshold expose only fixed Tool Search control tools.
Removing or adding a hidden tool leaves provider toolsHash and prefixShapeHash unchanged.
Below-threshold and explicit enabled=false paths preserve the original tool array and do not expose controls.
Removed tools stay out of the catalog and cannot be silently called through the Tool Search surface.
No provider cache-control, keepalive, TTL or permissions behavior was changed.
